ei.title: Resilience: From Ancient Survival to Modern Living
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: Resilience is when the unexpected happens but we keep our nerve and handle whatever challenge is resting in our lap. Resilience is necessary for our physical survival, for our mental and physical well-being, for our ability to realise our potential, and for the successful achievement of our life goals. At a basic, primitive level, our primary goal as humans is physical survival; the avoidance of death for as long as possible despite its inevitability. Resilience is vital for our survival, both as individual human beings and as a species. In ancient times, resilience would have been required to fend off much more overt dangers like being mauled to death by an animal whilst out hunting for food. Imagine if, in those times when survival was the order of the day, a man stood frozen with fear upon seeing a predator appear in front of him. Regardless of whether that man was expecting to encounter such a threat during that hunting trip, he would need to keep his nerve and either fight the animal or flee from it. Those would be the only survival options available to him. Without a can-do attitude and quick problem-solving followed by quick action, that man would be dead. In the modern day we are still fighting for our survival but now our needs are more complicated, even though they still ultimately serve to keep us alive. Modern survival means having enough money for fuel, clothing and shelter; thoughtfully looking after our bodies well enough to prevent life-threatening illness; fulfilling our potential in order to easily maintain emotional well-being which, in addition to making life worth living, directly and indirectly affects our ability to achieve our basic survival needs for fuel, clothing and shelter; and creating a family or social network to keep us feeling valued and, as research suggests, enabling a longer lifespan.

det.analysis:
✅ ① necessary - vital - complicated = 원문과 일치
❌ ② optional(선택적인): 회복탄력성이 생존에 '필수적'이라는 원문과 정반대
❌ ③ trivial(사소한): 회복탄력성이 생존에 '필수적(vital)'이라는 원문과 정반대
❌ ④ simple(단순한): 현대의 필요가 더 '복잡해졌다'는 원문과 정반대
det.tip: Resilience is necessary(필수적)→vital(필수적)→modern needs are more complicated(복잡한)로 이어지는 논지를 기억하자.

❌ ② create(만들다): 도전을 만드는 것이 아니라 대처하는 것
❌ ④ avoid(피하다): 피하는 것이 아니라 맞서 처리하는 것
det.tip: handle whatever challenge = manage whatever challenge. 어떤 도전이든 '처리하다'라는 의미이다.

questions.passage: Resilience is when the unexpected happens but we keep our nerve and handle whatever challenge is resting in our lap. Resilience is necessary for our physical survival, for our mental and physical well-being, for our ability to realise our potential, and for the successful achievement of our life goals. At a basic, primitive level, our primary goal as humans is physical survival; the avoidance of death for as long as possible despite its inevitability. Resilience is <u>vital</u> for our survival, both as individual human beings and as a species. In ancient times, resilience would have been required to fend off much more overt dangers like being mauled to death by an animal whilst out hunting for food. Imagine if, in those times when survival was the order of the day, a man stood frozen with fear upon seeing a predator appear in front of him. Regardless of whether that man was expecting to encounter such a threat during that hunting trip, he would need to keep his nerve and either fight the animal or flee from it. Those would be the only survival options available to him. Without a can-do attitude and quick problem-solving followed by quick action, that man would be dead. In the modern day we are still fighting for our survival but now our needs are more complicated, even though they still ultimately serve to keep us alive. Modern survival means having enough money for fuel, clothing and shelter; thoughtfully looking after our bodies well enough to prevent life-threatening illness; fulfilling our potential in order to easily maintain emotional well-being which, in addition to making life worth living, directly and indirectly affects our ability to achieve our basic survival needs for fuel, clothing and shelter; and creating a family or social network to keep us feeling valued and, as research suggests, enabling a longer lifespan.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 vital과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ essential(필수적인): vital과 '없어서는 안 되는'이라는 의미가 가장 가깝다
❌ ① harmful(해로운): 의미가 완전히 다름
❌ ② minor(사소한): vital의 반의어에 가까움
❌ ③ temporary(일시적인): 중요도가 아닌 시간적 성격을 나타냄
det.tip: Resilience is vital for our survival = Resilience is essential for our survival.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 flee와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② escape(도망치다): flee와 '위험에서 빠져나가다'라는 의미가 가장 가깝다
❌ ① attack(공격하다): 본문에서 fight가 이미 공격의 의미이며 flee는 반대 행동
❌ ③ approach(접근하다): 위험에서 도망치는 것과 반대

det.tip: fight the animal or flee from it(동물과 싸우거나 도망치다). flee = escape = run away.

det.analysis:
✅ ④ concealed(숨겨진): overt(공공연한, 노골적인)의 반의어로 가장 적절하다
❌ ① obvious(명백한): overt의 유의어
❌ ② visible(보이는): overt의 유의어
❌ ③ apparent(분명한): overt의 유의어
det.tip: overt(노골적인, 공공연한) ↔ concealed(숨겨진) / covert(은밀한). 드러남 vs 숨김의 대비이다.

questions.passage:
(A) Resilience is when the unexpected happens but we keep our nerve and handle whatever challenge is resting in our lap.
(B) The dentist accidentally touched a nerve during the procedure, causing sharp pain throughout her jaw.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 nerve의 의미로 가장 적절하게 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) keep our nerve에서 nerve는 '침착함/담력'을 의미하며 / (B) touched a nerve는 해부학적 '신경'을 의미
❌ ② (A)에서 nerve는 해부학적 신경이 아닌 '침착함'의 뜻
❌ ③ '뻔뻔함(have the nerve to)'은 (B)에 해당하지 않음
❌ ④ 의미가 (A)(B) 모두 맞지 않음
det.tip: nerve: (1) keep one's nerve = 침착함/담력 유지, (2) 해부학적 신경(신경세포), (3) have the nerve = 뻔뻔함. 문맥으로 구분해야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the ability to recover quickly from difficulties; toughness"

det.analysis:
✅ ③ resilience(회복탄력성): 어려움에서 빨리 회복하는 능력이라는 정의와 정확히 일치
❌ ① avoidance(회피): 피하는 행위이지 회복 능력이 아님
❌ ② inevitability(불가피성): 피할 수 없는 성질이지 회복과 무관
❌ ④ achievement(성취): 달성한 결과이지 회복 능력이 아님
det.tip: resilience = the ability to recover quickly from difficulties. 본문의 핵심 주제어이다.

questions.passage: At a basic, primitive level, our primary goal as humans is physical survival; the __________ (avoid) of death for as long as possible despite its inevitability.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 정관사 'the' 뒤 주어 자리에 명사 형태가 와야 한다.
det.analysis: 정관사 'the' 뒤에서 'of death'와 결합하는 주어 자리이므로 동사 'avoid'를 명사형 'avoidance'로 바꿔야 한다. 'the avoidance of death'는 '죽음의 회피'라는 의미이다.
det.tip: 동사 avoid → 명사 avoidance. the + 명사 + of 구조에 유의하자.

questions.passage: Modern survival means having enough money for fuel, clothing and shelter; __________ (thought) looking after our bodies well enough to prevent life-threatening illness.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 동사 'looking after'를 수식하는 부사 형태가 와야 한다.
det.analysis: 동명사 'looking after'를 수식해야 하므로 명사 'thought'를 부사형 'thoughtfully'로 바꿔야 한다. 'thoughtfully looking after'는 '신중하게 돌보는 것'이라는 의미이다.
det.tip: 명사 thought → 형용사 thoughtful → 부사 thoughtfully. 동사(구)를 수식할 때는 부사 형태를 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 그 시대의 가장 중요한 일, 최우선 과제
det.analysis:
✅ ② the order of the day(최우선 과제): 생존이 그 시대의 '최우선 과제'였다는 문맥에 정확히 맞는 관용구이다.
